name: ACDEV LTX-2.5 Studio
readme:
# ACDEV LTX-2.5 Studio

LTX-2.5 filmmaking interfaces for ComfyUI. Select an NVIDIA GPU; A100 80 GB is the recommended starting point. Attach persistent storage at /workspace (250 GB recommended).

Set HF_TOKEN through RunPod Secrets before first use, and accept the gated LTX-2.5 terms on Hugging Face. The pod downloads model weights automatically on first start. Open ComfyUI on port 8188 after provisioning completes.

Seven workflows: Image to Video, Text to Video, First and Last Frame, Audio to Video, Text to Audio, Two Stage Advanced, and Ingredients. Generated files are saved under /workspace/ComfyUI/output.

S3-compatible output backup is optional and disabled by default. Add credentials using RunPod Secrets and set REALTIME_BACKUP=true to enable it. Jupyter and SSH are optional. Review the full project README and deployment guide for configuration and current hardware validation status.
